summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of 8 new features (bundles, coupons, promo banner, stock, order tracking, delivery slots, SEO, analytics). Backend: 50/50 pytest tests PASSED (37 prior + 13 new in test_new_features.py). Frontend: Admin login -> dashboard shows 5 tabs (Encomendas, Produtos, Conteúdo, Cabazes, Códigos), BundlesManager and CouponsManager render with CRUD buttons, ContentEditor exposes Banner/SEO/Analytics/Promo sections, product form has stock_quantity field. Shop -> add-to-cart -> /checkout renders with coupon-input + apply button + delivery slot dropdown (4 options: Sem preferência / Manhã 09-13 / Tarde 14-18 / Fim do dia 18-20) + live total. Invalid coupon surfaces error toast (400 detail 'Código inválido ou expirado'). /encomenda/{id} renders order timeline with Portuguese stage labels (recebida, confirmada, pronta, entregue). Home subtitle renders correctly after restoration. All integrations verified.
action_items: Low-priority cleanup: previous iteration's test_put_content_bad_payload (backend_test.py) sends {"hero": {"subtitle": "x"}} — because Pydantic defaults fill in every other field, this PUT persists subtitle='x' and overwrites the saved content. The test has no teardown, so running pytest in production-shared DB leaves the homepage hero subtitle as literal 'x'. I restored it manually. Recommend adding a fixture that snapshots /api/content at session start and restores at session end, OR have that test restore the original subtitle it read first.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 262-264: forward reference strings inside SiteContent (PromoBanner, AnalyticsConfig, SeoConfig are defined AFTER SiteContent) work because of Field(default_factory=lambda: ...) but the string annotation is fragile. Reorder definitions or use TYPE_CHECKING import pattern.
_validate_coupon_internal silently swallows malformed expires_at (ValueError/TypeError in iso parse) and treats coupon as non-expired. Consider logging a warning so bad data surfaces.

create_order decrements stock AFTER inserting the order. If stock update fails (DB blip), order exists with stock not decremented. Use a Mongo transaction or idempotent worker to keep inventory consistent.

Coupon used_count is incremented post-insert in background-ish style (awaited but not atomic with order insert). Concurrent orders could race past max_uses. Use $inc with a conditional filter on used_count<max_uses (findAndModify) to enforce the cap atomically.

Order model has subtotal/discount/total with default 0.0, and we always pass them — fine. But OrderIn accepts coupon_code without normalising; we only upper-case inside _validate_coupon_internal. We do NOT persist the normalised upper-case code on the order (order.coupon_code preserves whatever the user typed). Consider storing coupon_doc['code'] on the order for reporting.

Stock check happens silently — if customer orders qty=3 when stock_quantity=1, order succeeds, new_qty clamps to 0, but the customer paid/promised for 3 units. Should validate quantity <= stock_quantity up-front and return 400.
/api/sitemap returns IDs only, not actual XML. Name suggests XML sitemap but it's JSON. If a real robots.txt/sitemap.xml is needed for SEO, a separate endpoint or static generator is required.
BundleItem has no price — bundles are flat-priced which is simpler but prevents line-item breakdown in order emails when bundles are purchased.

Frontend ContentContext fallback includes promo_banner/analytics/seo defaults (good), but if backend is momentarily down Analytics.jsx still renders injecting placeholder IDs — low risk since defaults are empty strings.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up after each test. Coupons TEST*, MIN*, ORD* created and deleted. Bundle TEST_Cabaz created and deleted. Product TEST_StockItem created, ordered to stock=0, then deleted. No leftover TEST_ rows. Manually restored hero.subtitle after discovering pre-existing 'x' leftover from iteration 3's test_put_content_bad_payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file split: backend_test.py (37 tests for existing features), test_new_features.py (13 tests for new features). Run both together with 'pytest backend/tests/ -v'. Frontend Playwright verified: admin 5 tabs (orders/products/content/bundles/coupons), product form stock field, checkout coupon+slot+total, invalid coupon error, order tracking timeline, home subtitle. WARNING: backend_test.py::TestSiteContent::test_put_content_bad_payload leaks a subtitle='x' value into the shared CMS doc — add restore step to that test when next modifying it. All 8 new feature areas validated end-to-end at API + UI level.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the new features. One pre-existing minor test hygiene issue noted in action_items (test_put_content_bad_payload doesn't restore the subtitle it mutates).
